components.name: Weekly Entry
components.description: A growing ruled row for a weekly topic and its artifact.
components.html:
01

Websites & Online Publishing

Portfolio shell created.
components.css: .ds-week { display:grid; grid-template-columns:4.5rem minmax(0,1fr); gap:1rem; padding:1.8rem 0 2rem; border-bottom:1px solid var(--rule); color:var(--ink); font-family:var(--font); } .ds-week:hover, .ds-week:focus-within, .ds-week:target { background:var(--blue-wash); } .ds-week-number { display:grid; place-items:center; width:2.65rem; height:2.65rem; background:var(--blue); color:var(--ink); font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; } .ds-week h3 { margin:0 0 .55rem; font-size:1.4rem; line-height:1.35; } .ds-week a { display:inline-block; min-height:44px; color:var(--ink); text-underline-offset:.2em; } .ds-week a:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--focus); outline-offset:5px; } .ds-week p { margin:0; color:var(--muted-ink); }

components.name: Text Link
components.description: Underlined navigation in the reading flow.
components.css: .ds-link { position:relative; display:inline-block; min-height:44px; color:var(--ink); font-family:var(--font); font-weight:600; text-underline-offset:.2em; } .ds-link::after { content:''; position:absolute; left:0; right:0; bottom:.08em; height:2px; background:var(--coral); transform:scaleX(0); transform-origin:left; transition:transform 220ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-link:hover::after, .ds-link:focus-visible::after, .ds-link:active::after { transform:scaleX(1); } .ds-link:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--focus); outline-offset:5px; }

narrative.overview: This is an editorial reading surface for six weeks of experiments. The interface gives each topic room to breathe and lets future artifacts, reflections, and embeds become the focus.

rules.name: The Coordinated Color Rule
rules.body: The page stays on warm off-white, with a plain section heading. Small week-number blocks cycle through blue, coral, yellow, and pink; soft matching washes appear on hover, focus within, or a linked target. Near-black ink carries the content and preserves contrast.

rules.name: The Growing Entry Rule
rules.body: Each weekly entry starts as a ruled row and grows vertically when a link, reflection, or embed is added.

rules.name: The Equivalent Response Rule
rules.body: Each weekly heading is a real permalink with a 44px minimum touch target. Hover, keyboard focus within, and touch navigation to the linked target produce matching row emphasis. The browse link receives a fast coral underline fill on hover, focus, and press. Reduced-motion settings keep the color feedback and remove movement.

dos: Do keep each week easy to scan and edit in place.
Do let the artifacts supply future visual interest.
donts: Don't add decorative imagery, large scroll animations, or extra navigation to this Week 1 shell.
